# pve_task_cancel (Action)

Stops a running task (`DELETE /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}`, upstream `stop_task`). The call returns once the stop request is delivered, not when the worker has exited; the cancelled task finishes with a non-OK exit status, so a subsequent `WaitForTask` on it reports failure by design. Requires the `Sys.Modify` privilege on `/nodes/{node}` unless the caller owns the task.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Stop a running vzdump task on node pve1. The task exits with a non-OK
# status afterwards.
action "pve_task_cancel" "stop_backup_task" {
  config {
    node = "pve1"
    upid = "UPID:pve1:0000ABCD:00000000:00000000:vzdump:100:root@pam:"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node the task runs on.
- `upid` (String) The task UPID to stop, e.g. `UPID:pve1:0000ABCD:...::vzdump:100:root@pam:`.
